about.title: A community where every learner matters
about.body:
Welcome to Redeemer's International Academy in Paynesville, Liberia. Our motto, “Academic and Moral Excellence,” expresses the standard we aim to uphold in learning, conduct and school life.

This website helps families explore the school, ask questions, request a visit and begin an admission application. The school office can explain current admission requirements and the next steps for your family.

academics.title: Learning beyond the classroom
academics.body: Our approach combines classroom teaching, consistent assessment, family participation and opportunities for students to develop personal responsibility. For grade availability, curriculum details, and enrollment requirements, contact the school office.

admissions.title: Begin your child's journey
admissions.body: Interested families can start an official application online. The school’s admissions team will review submitted information and communicate the next steps.

families.title: Student & family resources
families.body: Students and guardians can use their secure accounts to view school notices, learning resources, attendance, grades and authorized tuition information.

sections.title: Our mission
sections.body: Our mission is to help learners grow in knowledge, character and responsibility through purposeful learning and cooperation between school and home.

sections.title: Our values
sections.body:
Learning: ask questions, practise skills and keep improving.
Integrity: speak honestly and take responsibility for actions.
Respect: treat people and shared spaces with care.
Service: contribute positively to the school and wider community.
Partnership: work together as learners, families and staff.

sections.title: Welcome from the Principal
sections.body:
Welcome to Redeemer's International Academy.

Choosing a school is an important decision for every family. We want our website to give you a clear introduction to our school and a practical way to contact us, arrange a visit or begin an application.

“Academic and Moral Excellence” asks us to value both what learners achieve and how they learn, treat others and contribute to their community. We look forward to working with families as partners in that journey.

Please contact the school office with your questions. We welcome the opportunity to explain our programmes and help you understand the next steps.

Principal, Redeemer's International Academy

parent-handbook.heading: Parent Handbook
parent-handbook.intro: Information for families about the topics covered by the school handbook.

sections.title: Handbook contents
sections.body:
1. Welcome, purpose, version date and approval authority.
2. School contacts, hours and calendar.
3. Arrival, attendance, late arrival, absence and collection arrangements.
4. Learning, homework, assessment and reporting.
5. Conduct, behaviour review and school-family concerns process.
6. Learner wellbeing, safeguarding and the school's named reporting contact.
7. Health, illness, medication, allergies and emergency arrangements.
8. Uniform, supplies, meals and transport/services actually offered.
9. Fees, approved payment channels and financial queries.
10. Privacy, photographs, school records and portal use.
11. Visits, events and communication expectations.
12. Acknowledgment and review date.
